edges.reason: Owned constructor hardcodes owner to a fixed address, granting all privileges to it.
transferOwnership writes attacker supplied _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership moves owner to newOwner without any additional check beyond msg.sender.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownership transfer.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to take ownership.
transfer uses msg.sender to read and write balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender for allowance and as callback argument.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token with msg.sender == owner.
safeAdd executes the addition c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
safeSub executes the subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul executes c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
safeDiv executes c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
transfer performs balance arithmetic and state writes for sender and recipient.
transferFrom performs balance and allowance arithmetic and state writes.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an attacker-controlled spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
Constructor sets symbol = BXB.
Constructor sets name = BLK BLOX COIN.
Constructor sets decimals = 18.
Constructor sets _totalSupply = 40000000000e18.
Constructor mints entire supply into balances[owner].
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance deductions.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an untrusted spender contract, enabling reentrancy.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 contract address.
Rescued tokens are always sent to the owner address.
